name: Claude
summary: Anthropic's AI assistant for writing, analysis and coding.
description: Claude is Anthropic's AI assistant (replacing the outdated 'Claude 3' entry) for writing, analysis, research and coding, with Artifacts, projects, connectors and Claude in Chrome. It is known for careful reasoning and long documents. A free plan is available on web, desktop and mobile; Pro costs $17/month billed annually ($20 monthly) and includes Claude Code, while Max starts at $100/month.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: A free plan is available on web, desktop and mobile; Pro costs $17/month billed annually ($20 monthly) and includes Claude Code, while Max starts at $100/month.

features: Artifacts and projects: Generate and iterate on code, documents, and visuals in dedicated side panels.
Long documents: Upload or paste large files for summarization, analysis, and research Q&A.
Connectors and Claude in Chrome: Pull context from apps such as Google Drive and Slack, or chat from the browser extension.
Careful reasoning: Strong performance on writing, analysis, and coding tasks.

howToUse.title: Sign in at Claude
howToUse.description: Create an account or log in at claude.ai on the web, desktop app, or mobile.

howToUse.title: Start a chat
howToUse.description: Type a prompt, paste a document, or ask for help with writing, analysis, research, or code.

howToUse.title: Use Artifacts and projects
howToUse.description: Open generated code or documents in Artifacts, or organize ongoing work in projects with shared instructions and files.

howToUse.title: Share or continue
howToUse.description: Copy outputs, export Artifacts, or return to long threads and project chats later.

features_fr: Artifacts et projets : génère et itère sur du code, des documents et des visuels dans des panneaux dédiés.
Documents longs : téléverse ou colle de gros fichiers pour les résumer, les analyser ou poser des questions de recherche.
Connecteurs et Claude in Chrome : récupère le contexte depuis des apps comme Google Drive et Slack, ou discute depuis l'extension navigateur.
Raisonnement soigneux : solide pour l'écriture, l'analyse et le code.
